 Oral Judgment

This appeal is filed by the appellant/petitioner under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988
challenging the judgment and award dated 11.03.2016 passed in MVC.No.855/2015 by the Xxi
Additional Small Causes Judge and M.A.C.T., Bengaluru, for enhancing the compensation.
2. Heard the arguments of both learned counsel for the parties.
3. The appellant/petitioner had filed petition before the tribunal seeking compensation of Rs.8,00,000/-.
The tribunal considering the entire evidence on record, granted an amount of Rs.3,09,455/-.

Aggrieved by the said order, the appellant/petitioner has preferred this appeal and mainly contending that she sustained injuries and undergone surgery by fixing the implants, but the tribunal has granted meager amounts under the other heads.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant contended that the appellant/petitioner met with an accident on 18.01.2015.
The said injuries are grevious in nature.
5. Though she was earning Rs.15,000/- per month from tailoring and saree business, the tribunal has taken her income at Rs.7,500/- per month and functional disability is to be taken as 50%.

Thus,
the appellant/petitioner is requested for enhancement of compensation.
6. The appellant/petitioner has examined by PW.3 - Dr.Ravish V.N.
The doctor assessed the disability of whole body at 15.33%.
The appellant/petitioner was aged about 37 years, working as a tailor and earning Rs.15,000/- per month, but she has not filed any income proof.

As she met with an accident in the year 2015, her notional income is to be NC: 2026:KHC:6583 HC-KAR taken at Rs.9,000/- per month as per the chart prepared by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority and the multiplier is '15'.

Therefore, the Loss of Future income comes to Rs.9,000 x 12 x 15 x 15 =
Rs.2,43,000/-.
